title: When an Entitled Man DEMANDS a Refund
description:
An officer arrived on the scene to trespass a male who refused to leave a motel despite multiple requests from the management while demanding a refund for his troubles. The male was reluctant to leave without his refund and soon tempers started to boil. It took three officers to subdue the male and they were also able to retrieve a 3 inch knife from his pocket. The male was charged with criminal trespassing and resisting arrest.
